summary: This directory defines the core domain models and data structures required to manage and track approval workflows, covering request lifecycle states, evaluation outcomes, and historical event recording.
responsibilities: Define the structure of approval requests and their associated challenges
Model the outcomes of approval policy evaluations
Track the lifecycle states of approval requests
Represent individual events within an approval workflow
relationships: An ApprovalRequest contains an ApprovalChallenge to define the nature of the request.
The ApprovalDecision provides the result of evaluating an ApprovalRequest against policies.
The ApprovalStatus tracks the current lifecycle phase of an ApprovalRequest.
An ApprovalRecord captures specific events that occur during the lifecycle of an ApprovalRequest.
designDecisions: Use of union types to represent finite states like ApprovalDecision and ApprovalStatus.
Strict separation between request metadata, challenge payloads, and decision outcomes.
Centralized model definitions for domain consistency.
